info.name: Lawyer Dashboard
info.description: Aggregated analytics for the Lawyers/Conveyancers entity dashboard. Single summary endpoint — client-scoped except SMR/TTR counts (those collections carry no client ref yet, so they are global).

request.description:
Returns all dashboard analytics in one call:

- **kpi** — totalClients, newThisMonth, kycVerifiedPct, highRiskClients, pendingEcdd, openCases, trustVolumeThisMonth, trustTxnsThisMonth, reviewsOverdue
- **clients** — byKycStatus (pending/in_review/verified/rejected), pep, sanctioned, newThisMonth
- **risk** — CRA distribution byLabel (Low/Medium/High/Unacceptable), avgScore
- **ecdd** — pendingCount + queue (cddGate true, ecddStatus Pending, max 8, newest first)
- **reviews** — dueSoonCount (30 days), overdueCount, upcoming list
- **cases** — Alert byStatus, open count, 5 most recent
- **trust** — 6-month monthly transaction trend (count + AUD volume), byType, thisMonth incl. flagged count
- **onboarding** — OnboardingJourney byStatus
- **reports** — SMR (draft/review/approved) and TTR (draft/submitted/approved) counts — GLOBAL scope
